# StudyWithFarhan

> Farhan Rivaldy's personal learning site about DevOps, cloud, Linux, networking, homelab, AI, and learning in public.

StudyWithFarhan is the personal website of Farhan Rivaldy, a DevOps Engineer who learns by building things, breaking things, and figuring out why they broke.

## Topics

- DevOps
- Cloud Computing
- Linux
- Networking
- Homelab
- Artificial Intelligence
- Large Language Models
